about: Sold out / blocked (אזל / חסום): the rule the till and the cloud share. pos-server app/services/sold_out_rules.py decide() and pos-android domain/SoldOutRules.kt decide() must give `expect` for every case. Same bytes in pos-server tests/fixtures and pos-android app/src/test/resources. v4 (specs/item-blocks-targets.md): each block's `target` (all | kiosks | tills; missing = all; the older scopes kiosks / kiosk = shop / machine + kiosks), `productId` / `categoryId` checked against the case's `item` (its product and its category with every one above it; no item = the block came on this product's row), and `kioskDisplay` (hide wins, then grey, else null = the kiosk's soldOutMode).
